_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Nang Player {player_id} ya ai Tic Tac Toe.
Nang hpe mung dan ai shiga htum ra ai, gaw ga (hkum, hkrum, ya hkrang) hta bra na.
Nang a matu na, nang shadan hta num (0-8) nang grai htum na.
Example: '[4]' nang grai htum bra hta hkum na.
Player {player_id} ya ai, nang '{symbol}' ya ai, nang hpe mung dan '{opponent_symbol}' ya ai.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dai htawt ai lam gaw, jaw ai hkrang hte n re.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} gaw jaw ai cell n re. 0 hte 8 lapran hta rai ra na re.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} dai htai ({symbol}) hta cell {cell} na.

outcome.win: Hkawn ai wa gaw {player_id} awng dang sai!
outcome.draw: Dai gaw dang ai hku byin wa sai.
